name: Brass Deadbolt Magnetic Scuffs
description: Microscopic circular scuff marks on the interior brass deadbolt thumbturn cylinder of Penthouse 4B.
detailedAnalysis: Forensic metallurgy confirms the scuffs were caused by high-flux rotational magnetic drag. A powerful Neodymium magnet applied to the exterior face of the wooden door can latch or unlatch the deadbolt from the outside corridor, making the door appear locked from the inside.

name: Adulterated Glencairn Glass
description: Glencairn whiskey glass containing single malt scotch heavily laced with dissolved pharmaceutical Midazolam.
detailedAnalysis: Spectrometry confirms 45mg of Midazolam dissolved in 30ml of scotch. A dosage of this magnitude induces unconsciousness and anterograde amnesia within 4 to 7 minutes, completely immobilizing the victim.

name: Oberlin Trust Audit Workbook
description: Unencrypted Excel workbook detailing $2,420,000 in diverted municipal escrow funds.
detailedAnalysis: Timothy's audit explicitly documents fraudulent transactions directed to Meridian Aesthetic Clinic (Dr. Sterling) and Aegis Horizon LLC (Corinne Blake). A highlighted memo notes that criminal referrals were scheduled for Monday morning.

name: Programmed Delayed Alarm Log
description: Honeywell alarm diagnostic record showing an automated test signal scheduled at 11:41 PM to fire at 11:47 PM.
detailedAnalysis: This single discovery shatters the initial premise of the case: the alarm did NOT signal an attack at 11:47 PM. The perpetrator set a 6-minute delay timer before leaving at 11:41 PM, giving them time to reach the basement before police were notified.

name: Utility Riser Dumbwaiter Hatch
description: A loosened wall hatch behind coats leading to a vertical conduit shaft.
detailedAnalysis: Internal inspection shows the shaft is obstructed by rigid 4-inch cast-iron steam pipes and high-voltage conduit. The maximum clearance is 6 inches. No human could possibly pass through this shaft.

name: Sealed 4th-Floor Sash Window
description: Double-hung kitchen window latched tightly from inside with undisturbed dust along the sill.
detailedAnalysis: Eliminates the possibility of window escape, grappling lines, or rooftop rappelling. The victim and perpetrator could only have exited through the front door.

name: Hallway Carpet Wheel Impressions
description: Damp twin wheel impressions on the crimson carpet leading from 4B to the freight elevator.
detailedAnalysis: Axle width is 30 inches; tire pattern matches industrial vulcanized rubber casters. Chemical swabs detect traces of medical-grade chlorhexidine disinfectant on the carpet fibers.

name: Obstructed Video Doorbell (Apt 4A)
description: Black PVC tape placed precisely over neighbor Toby Ray's doorbell camera.
detailedAnalysis: Adhesive residue analysis indicates the tape was applied between 11:10 PM and 11:20 PM. The camera failed to record hallway movements during the critical abduction window.

name: Freight Elevator Keyhole Flakes
description: Fresh brass shavings in the manual keyed override cylinder of the 4th-floor freight elevator.
detailedAnalysis: The lift was manually commanded to hold at floor 4 during the 11:35 PM to 11:44 PM window, then dispatched directly to the basement dock.

name: Cleanly Sheared Stairwell Sensor
description: Magnetic reed switch contact wire cleanly snipped on the 4th-floor fire exit.
detailedAnalysis: The cut was made using medical surgical wire cutters or heavy bandage shears, silencing the stairwell door siren.

name: Visitor Register Entry ('Dr. V. Martin')
description: Guest log entry at 11:22 PM for 'Dr. V. Martin, MD' visiting Penthouse 4B.
detailedAnalysis: No doctor by that name exists in state medical registries. Graphological comparison confirms identical stroke pressure, character spacing, and capital 'D' loops to Dr. Eleanor Sterling's authentic signature.

name: Lobby CCTV Still (11:24 PM)
description: High-resolution camera capture of a woman in a dark hooded trench coat carrying a structured doctor's kit.
detailedAnalysis: The calfskin medical satchel features custom brass initials 'E.S.' on the clasp, directly matching Dr. Eleanor Sterling's personal equipment.

name: Overdraft Notice & Rolex Pawn Ticket
description: Final debt demand for $18,410 alongside a $4,200 pawn receipt in Gregory Vance's mailbox.
detailedAnalysis: Establishes Gregory Vance's urgent, crippling financial vulnerability on the day of the crime.

name: Monogrammed Wet Umbrella ('C.B.')
description: Burberry umbrella dripping rainwater in the foyer stand with monogram 'C.B.'.
detailedAnalysis: Rain did not begin falling until 11:10 PM tonight, proving Corinne Blake entered the building shortly after that time.

name: Keycard Server Audit Log
description: Digital log of Master Keycard #2 (Gregory Vance) overrides at 11:40 PM and 11:52 PM.
detailedAnalysis: Conclusively proves Gregory Vance operated the 4th-floor freight elevator at 11:40 PM and opened the basement service exit at 11:52 PM, directly refuting his boiler-room alibi.

name: Cam 03 Blackout Log (11:41 - 11:53 PM)
description: A 12-minute corrupted footage blackout on the subterranean loading bay camera.
detailedAnalysis: The DVR log records manual cable disconnection at 11:41 PM and reconnection at 11:53 PM from panel B-4, accessible only from the security office.

name: Handwritten Bribery Memo
description: Crumpled memo instructing: 'Kill Cam 3 at 11:40 sharp. Hold freight lift at 4th floor. 20k balance delivered...'
detailedAnalysis: Written with green clinical ink on memo stock identical to prescription pads from Meridian Aesthetic & Surgical Clinic.

name: Neodymium Retrieval Magnet
description: 180-lb pull cylindrical neodymium rare-earth magnet wrapped in protective felt in Gregory's locker.
detailedAnalysis: The circular diameter and magnetic field shape perfectly match the concentric microscopic scuffs discovered on Penthouse 4B's interior deadbolt cylinder.

name: Concealed HVAC Shotgun Microphone
description: Sennheiser directional microphone transmitting on 915.4 MHz inside the 4B air vent.
detailedAnalysis: Traced directly to the multi-channel receiver on neighbor Toby Ray's studio console in 4A.

name: Sobranie Cigarette Butts & Lipstick
description: Two crushed Sobranie Black Russian gold-tipped butts bearing Chanel Rouge Allure #99 lipstick.
detailedAnalysis: Found in the rooftop shelter. Proves Corinne Blake was on the roof during the storm tonight, destroying her claim that she never came to Meridian Court.

name: Size 9 Vibram Boot Print
description: Boot impression on the terrace parapet matching Toby Ray's Red Wing boots.
detailedAnalysis: Confirms Toby climbed onto the roof earlier in the evening to service his eavesdropping microphone.

name: Rusted Fire Escape Mechanism
description: Fire escape counterweight rusted solid with undisturbed cobwebs.
detailedAnalysis: Rules out any suspect escaping or abducting someone via the exterior fire ladder.

name: Canvas Laundry Cart Biological Traces
description: Industrial hamper with wheel tracks matching 4th-floor carpet, containing saliva and hair matching Timothy Vance.
detailedAnalysis: Conclusively proves Timothy Vance was transported down in this cart while unconscious, rather than walking or vanishing by supernatural means.

name: Empty Midazolam Ampoule (Batch #MR-8821)
description: Spent pharmaceutical glass vial retrieved from the basement refuse hopper.
detailedAnalysis: Batch MR-8821 was distributed exclusively to Dr. Eleanor Sterling's surgical practice, tying her directly to the chemical weapon used against the victim.

name: Parking Stub (11:15 PM) & Warm Volvo Engine
description: Parking ticket inside Corinne Blake's Volvo stamped 11:15 PM in the building's underground garage.
detailedAnalysis: Directly contradicts Corinne's statement that she was in bed in Greenwich by 10:30 PM.

name: Sprinter Van Dual-Tire Impressions
description: Tire impressions of a private medical transport van speeding out the alley shutter at 11:58 PM.
detailedAnalysis: Tire tread matches the private unmarked ambulance owned by Meridian Aesthetic Clinic.

name: Gregory Vance's Lift Override Confession
description: Gregory admits receiving $5,000 to operate the freight elevator and black out Camera 3 for a private extraction.
detailedAnalysis: Gregory confirms he did not kidnap Timothy himself, but held the lift at floor 4 for a female client who entered Apt 4B.

name: Gregory Vance's Magnetic Lock Testimony
description: Gregory testifies he explained the magnetic deadbolt bypass trick to the client and provided the cylinder magnet.
detailedAnalysis: Explains how the door was locked from the outside after wheeling Timothy out in the laundry hamper.

name: Corinne Blake's Panic Visit Admission
description: Corinne admits arriving at 11:15 PM, knocking on 4B with no reply, and hiding on the roof.
detailedAnalysis: Confirms she was present to beg Timothy to suppress the audit, but found the door unanswered at 11:20 PM.

name: Corinne's Rooftop Noise Witness Testimony
description: Corinne heard a rolling metal cart in the service corridor at 11:44 PM followed by a van engine in the alley.
detailedAnalysis: Independent auditory confirmation that the victim was moved prior to the 11:47 PM panic alarm.

name: Toby Ray's Wiretap Confession
description: Toby admits to installing the eavesdropping microphone on 4B for a corporate client.
detailedAnalysis: Establishes Toby as an illicit wiretapper rather than the physical perpetrator of the kidnapping.

name: Audio Tape Recording (11:32 - 11:44 PM)
description: Audio log capturing a female voice urging Timothy to drink, a body collapsing at 11:38 PM, and cart wheels rolling at 11:44 PM.
detailedAnalysis: Irrefutable real-time proof that Timothy was incapacitated at 11:38 PM and removed at 11:44 PM—three minutes BEFORE the alarm was triggered.

name: Dr. Sterling's Admission of Midnight Visit
description: Dr. Sterling admits entering 4B at 11:24 PM under a false name to 'administer sedatives'.
detailedAnalysis: Places the perpetrator at the scene with sedative pharmaceuticals during the precise window of the crime.

name: Dr. Sterling's Full Abduction Confession
description: Dr. Sterling admits drugging Timothy, moving him in the laundry cart, locking the deadbolt with a magnet, and holding him in the Catskills.
detailedAnalysis: Full confession exposing the entire conspiracy, motive, and location of the living victim.
